system.description:
When your opponent lets down its guard, you open it up to additional attacks.

Prerequisites: Combat Reflexes, Opportunistic Trickery

Effect: Whenever an opponent provokes an Attack of Opportunity from you, once per turn you can sacrifice the attack to reduce the target's Reflex Defense by 5 until the end of the target's next turn.
